title: Soild Ground
speaker: Ps Andrew Cartledge
blurb:
Solid ground sounds obvious until you realise how many things in your life are quietly pretending to be it.

Ps Andrew Cartledge takes the familiar parable of the wise and foolish builders and works backwards through it, stopping at a conversation Jesus had in front of a pagan shrine at Caesarea Philippi. Standing in the shadow of temples to Caesar and the god Pan, Jesus asks his disciples the question he is still asking now. The answer Peter gives is extraordinary. What comes immediately after it is not.

There is also something in here about the slab under Andrew's house, 72 piers sunk 4.2 metres into Wimmera clay, and why solid ground is never something you work out by yourself.
